protocol.settleRule: Minimum pause, autosave no longer saving, and two rAF callbacks before each action; actions/assertions outside the timed operation are excluded.
protocol.tabRule: Actual detail→palette and palette→detail, separate operations with explicit aria-pressed preconditions.
protocol.dragRule: First motion jumps12 CSSpx (above production3px threshold); primary event must move≥8px; live preview, committed pose, singleUndo, Redo and restoration checked.
protocol.colourRule: Actual quickColor control fill + Tab; input/change/blur recorded. Native colour-picker window latency excluded.
protocol.quantile: Nearest rank ceil(n*p). At20 samples P95 is second largest; fixed sample count and no removal of outliers.

measurement: Capture-phase performance.now() to next/second rAF callback execution; presentation opportunities, not actual pixel/photon paint. rAF callback intervals are not continuous rendered FPS. Playwright wall time is reported separately.

protocol.gesture: Round-robin selected panel text: actual HEX input then Enter; one semantic commit; Undo/Redo after timing.
protocol.measurement: Input/Enter capture-phase timestamps to next/second rAF callback execution. Not optical latency or continuous FPS.
protocol.memorySampling: CDP Performance.getMetrics and Memory.getDOMCounters at baseline, after input preview, after commit, after Undo/Redo, and final, including all three warmup and twenty measured gestures. Maximum is an observed stage-sampled high-water mark, not a continuous peak; no forced GC, process RSS, native/GPU memory or allocation-complete claim.
protocol.trace: CDP timeline spans all gestures, selections, downloads and validation. Event categories may overlap; trace totals are not independent additive wall time.

separateFourPanelDiagnostic.scope: Separate4x120 synthetic editor fixture,3warm+20measured real input/Enter gestures. Not pooled with v2. Stage-sampled heap/DOM high-water is not RSS or a continuous true peak.

retainedPreflightObservation.kind: Overbroad all-name process gate stopped before Chrome or formal capture; preserved separately, then classified by actual ownership and protected-user identity under explicit root direction.

scope: Fixed sequential captures on one Windows device. All8operation/size rows and4metrics retained, including slower results. Descriptive differences are not statistical significance, optical latency, continuous FPS or controlled thermal/scheduling/background equivalence.
